item.title: Reaction to Ravens Hiring Jesse Minter
item.description: Team insiders Ryan Mink and Garrett Downing share their initial reactions to the Ravens' decision to hire Jesse Minter as their next head coach, including the leadership he'll bring to Baltimore, why he's set up to succeed as a first-time head coach, how he'll elevate the defense, who could be his offensive coordinator, and more.

item.title: Jesse Minter's Coaching Principles
item.description: Team insiders Ryan Mink and Garrett Downing look back on an interview new Ravens Head Coach Jesse Minter did with John Harbaugh and the Harbaugh Coaching Academy to get an idea of Minter's coaching beliefs.

item.title: Rick Minter Talks About His Son's Return to Baltimore, Coaching Roots & More
item.description: Team insiders Ryan Mink and Garrett Downing speak with Rick Minter, father of new Head Coach Jesse Minter and longtime coach himself, about how Jesse has grown as a coach, what makes him ready to be a head coach for the first time, what his defense will look like, when his family knew he was destined for coaching, and more.

item.title: Takeaways From Jesse Minter's Introductory Press Conference
item.description: Team insiders Ryan Mink and Garrett Downing discuss the arrival of new Ravens Head Coach Jesse Minter, including the principles he showed, the process that led to this position, his expectations for the team, and much more.

item.title: Jesse Minter's Introductory Press Conference: Ravens Press Conference 1/29/26
item.description: Head Coach Jesse Minter, President Sashi Brown, and General Manager Eric DeCosta speak with the media.
